transcript: So I actually don't think that there were important values absent from my top few societies. I do think maybe if I had to pick one, there is, it was very focused on the basic needs of humans, right? eating, sleeping, breathing, your physical needs on the hierarchical scale. But I think we all know as humans, we need a higher purpose in life to feel fulfilled. And that's part of the reason I chose the societies that focused on community is because community can give you a purpose in life. Um, but there's, there's not a ton of room here for creativity and, um, passion and purpose. It's just kind of fulfilling your basic physical human needs and not any of those psychological needs.
